description: This file declares the interface and class definitions for WebAudioPlayer and its factory within the Rialto client media component. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and member variables related to WebAudioPlayer functionality, IPC, and client control.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating WebAudioPlayer instances, implementing IWebAudioPlayerFactory.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing IWebAudioPlayer, IWebAudioPlayerIpcClient, and IControlClient, managing Web Audio playback, IPC, and client control.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new IWebAudioPlayer instance with specified client, mime type, priority, and config.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data buffer to the player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the WebAudioPlayer client.
